where: World Eaters catalogue: every summary and gist an import can place (verify/sources/hand/catalog-world-eaters.json ai; data.js FACTIONS for the four existing detachments)

judgement.check: The catalogue is read (aiRead): verify/catalog-armies.js places, for each of the 8 detachments, every World Eaters datasheet once and each enhancement on a bearer its words allow, and verify/lines.js holds every placed line to its summary (LM), its numbers (LN) and its labels (L0). New AI text, per docs/summaries.md, each to be checked against its GW words below. Idols of Khorne: its sumDef is one plain line ("If Idol of Blessed Blood is active, …"), not an "<option> ⇒" line: the program places the When targeted line with no option (its defence box carries opt, but the When targeted line takes options only from RULE_OPTIONS); its sumSt plain too, since reader 1 reads the Burning Wrath stat box without its option (on: aura only).

world-eaters/bloodletters · Daemonic Ico.gw: Models in the bearer’s unit have a Leadership characteristic of 6+.

world-eaters/bloodcrushers · Daemonic Ic.gw: Models in the bearer’s unit have a Leadership characteristic of 6+.

summary.sumOv: At the start of each battle round, if the Khorne Lord of Skulls is on the battlefield: roll one additional D6 for the Blessings of Khorne roll

world-eaters/khorne-lord-of-skulls · Ido.gw: At the start of the battle round, if this model is on the battlefield, when you make a **Blessings of Khorne roll**, roll one additional D6.

summary.sumAtk: vs the closest eligible MONSTER or VEHICLE target within 18", ranged: re-roll Wound rolls and Damage rolls

world-eaters/chaos-predator-annihilator.gw: Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** target within 18", you can re-roll the **Wound roll** and you can re-roll the Damage roll.

summary.sumDef: If the attacker is suppressed (a non-MONSTER/VEHICLE enemy unit the Chaos Predator Destructor hit in your Shooting phase): −1 to Hit rolls

world-eaters/chaos-predator-destructor ·.gw: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks (excluding **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**). Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the **Hit roll**.

summary.sumAtk: vs units that can FLY: +1 to Hit rolls

world-eaters/heldrake · Airborne Predato.gw: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a unit that can **FLY**, add 1 to the **Hit roll**.

summary.sumDef: Once per turn, after an enemy unit fights this unit, if it uses this ability: this unit fights next, even if it has already fought

world-eaters/helbrute · Frenzy.gw: In the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets this unit, after that unit has resolved its attacks, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit is **eligible to fight** (even if it has already fought this phase) and must be **selected to fight** next.

summary.sumAtk: In melee, vs enemy units below Starting Strength: +1 to Hit rolls; also +1 to Wound rolls if they are Below Half-strength

world-eaters/maulerfiend · Savage Exalta.gw: Each time this model makes a melee attack that targets an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the **Hit roll** and, if that attack targets an enemy unit that is **Below Half-strength**, add 1 to the **Wound roll** as well.

summary.sumAtk: Idol of Infinite Rage (Aura) ⇒ If Idol of Infinite Rage is active, within 6" of a WORLD EATERS MONSTER (9" if TITANIC): +1 to Hit rolls and +1 to Wound rolls
summary.sumDef: If Idol of Blessed Blood is active, within 6" of a WORLD EATERS MONSTER (9" if TITANIC): 4+ invulnerable save
summary.sumSt: If Idol of Burning Wrath is active, within 6" of a WORLD EATERS MONSTER (9" if TITANIC): +1" Move; +1 to Advance and Charge rolls
summary.sumOv: In your Command phase, pick one Idols of Khorne ability for WORLD EATERS MONSTER and TITANIC units until your next Command phase, each once per battle: Idol of Infinite Rage, Idol of Burning Wrath or Idol of Blessed Blood

cult-of-blood · Idols of Khorne.gw:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Idols of Khorne abilities listed below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability is active and its effects apply to all **WORLD EATERS TITANIC** and **WORLD EATERS MONSTER** units from your army. You can only select each Idols of Khorne ability once per battle.
**Idol of Infinite Rage (Aura)**
While a friendly **JAKHALS** or **GOREMONGERS** unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is **TITANIC**), each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the **Hit roll** and add 1 to the **Wound roll**.
**Idol of Burning Wrath (Aura)**
While a friendly **JAKHALS** or **GOREMONGERS** unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is **TITANIC**), add 1" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and add 1 to **Advance** and **Charge rolls** made for that unit.
**Idol of Blessed Blood (Aura)**
While a friendly **JAKHALS** or **GOREMONGERS** unit is within 6" of this model (or within 9" if this model is **TITANIC**), models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
KEYWORDS
**JAKHALS** and **GOREMONGERS** units from your army have the **BATTLELINE** keyword.

summary.sumOv: The bearer has the Infiltrators ability

cult-of-blood · Butcher Lord.gw: **WORLD EATERS INFANTRY** model only. The bearer has the Infiltrators ability.

cult-of-blood · Brazen Form.gw: **WORLD EATERS MONSTER** model only. Add 1 to the bearer’s Toughness characteristic and the bearer has the **Feel No Pain 5+** ability.

summary.sumOv: After deployment: redeploy up to three JAKHALS and/or GOREMONGERS units, Strategic Reserves allowed whatever their number

cult-of-blood · Strategic Slaughter.gw: **WORLD EATERS** model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three **JAKHALS** and/or **GOREMONGERS** units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in **Strategic Reserves**, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

summary.gist: when a WORLD EATERS MONSTER or TITANIC unit is destroyed by an enemy unit: JAKHALS and GOREMONGERS can re-roll Hit rolls vs that enemy unit

gw.target: One **WORLD EATERS MONSTER** or **WORLD EATERS TITANIC** unit from your army that was just destroyed by an enemy unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
gw.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a model in a **JAKHALS** or **GOREMONGERS** unit from your army makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your unit, you can re-roll the **Hit roll**.

summary.gist: once per battle, when a JAKHALS unit is destroyed: an identical unit at Starting Strength goes into Strategic Reserves (not CHARACTER units of Attached units)

gw.target: One **JAKHALS** unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
gw.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in **Strategic Reserves**, at its Starting Strength.
gw.restrictions: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed **CHARACTER** units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

summary.gist: JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS, when targeted: Feel No Pain 6+ (5+ within 6" of a WORLD EATERS MONSTER or 9" of a WORLD EATERS TITANIC)

gw.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
gw.target: One **JAKHALS** or **GOREMONGERS** unit from your army that was selected as the target as one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
gw.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the **Feel No Pain 6+** ability. If your unit is within 6" of one or more friendly **WORLD EATERS MONSTER** units, or within 9" of one or more friendly **WORLD EATERS TITANIC** units, your unit has the **Feel No Pain 5+** ability instead.

summary.gist: JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS models within 3" of enemy models can fight, attacking an enemy unit within 3" of them and in Engagement Range of their unit

gw.target: One **JAKHALS** or **GOREMONGERS** unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase and is within **Engagement Range** of one or more enemy units.
gw.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to fight, when determining which models in it are eligible to fight, any models in your unit that are within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3" of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.

summary.gist: JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS: re-roll Hit rolls of 1 (all Hit rolls within 6" of a WORLD EATERS MONSTER or 9" of a WORLD EATERS TITANIC)

gw.target: One **JAKHALS** or **GOREMONGERS** unit from your army.
gw.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a **Hit roll** of 1. If that model’s unit is within 6" of one or more friendly **WORLD EATERS MONSTER** units, or within 9" of one or more friendly **WORLD EATERS TITANIC** units, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

summary.gist: once per battle: a WORLD EATERS MONSTER or TITANIC unit has the Idol of Infinite Rage, Burning Wrath or Blessed Blood instead of the army’s, even one already used

gw.target: One **WORLD EATERS MONSTER** or **WORLD EATERS TITANIC** unit from your army.
gw.effect: Select the Idol of Infinite Rage, Idol of Burning Wrath or Idol of Blessed Blood. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Idols of Khorne ability is active for your unit instead of any other Idols of Khorne ability that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that ability this battle.
gw.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

possessed-slaughterbound · Frenzied Focu.gw: **WORLD EATERS DAEMON** model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified **Hit roll** of 5+, instead of only a 6.

summary.gist: WORLD EATERS POSSESSED, when targeted: −1 to Wound rolls for attacks on this unit

gw.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
gw.target: One **WORLD EATERS POSSESSED** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
gw.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the **Wound roll**.

summary.gist: WORLD EATERS POSSESSED: +1 Damage vs models not MONSTER/VEHICLE if EIGHTBOUND, vs MONSTER/VEHICLE models if EXALTED EIGHTBOUND

gw.target: One **WORLD EATERS POSSESSED** unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
gw.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack made by a model in your unit is allocated to an enemy model, if your unit has the **EIGHTBOUND** keyword and that enemy model is not a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE**, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack. If your unit has the **EXALTED EIGHTBOUND** keyword and that enemy model is a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE**, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack instead.

summary.gist: WORLD EATERS POSSESSED, when targeted: models destroyed before they have fought fight after the attacking unit, then are removed

gw.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
gw.target: One **WORLD EATERS POSSESSED** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
gw.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

summary.gist: an EXALTED EIGHTBOUND unit arriving by Deep Strike can be set up more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units; it cannot charge this turn

gw.target: One **EXALTED EIGHTBOUND** unit from your army that is arriving using the **Deep Strike** ability this phase.
gw.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
gw.restrictions: A unit targeted with this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

summary.gist: a WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit moves through enemy models (not MONSTERS/VEHICLES) and ends only a Charge move within Engagement Range of them; Desperate Escape tests are passed automatically

gw.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
gw.target: One **WORLD EATERS POSSESSED** unit from your army that has not been selected to move or declare a charge this phase.
gw.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a **Normal**, **Advance**, Fall Back or **Charge move**, it can move through enemy models (excluding **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**). When doing so, it can move within **Engagement Range** of such models but, unless that move was a Charge move, it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

summary.gist: each enemy unit in Engagement Range of a WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit takes a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1

gw.target: One **WORLD EATERS POSSESSED** unit from your army.
gw.effect: Each enemy unit within **Engagement Range** of your unit must take a **Battle-shock test**, subtracting 1 from that test.

summary.sumAtk: If this unit disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn: melee [LANCE]

goretrack-onslaught · Rush to the Fray.gw: Each time a **WORLD EATERS** unit from your army disembarks from a **TRANSPORT**, until the end of the turn, add 1 to **Charge rolls** made for that unit and that unit’s melee weapons have the **[lance]** ability.

summary.sumOv: If the bearer starts the battle embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT: that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has Scouts 9"

goretrack-onslaught · Aggressive Deploym.gw: **WORLD EATERS** model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, if the bearer starts the battle embarked within a **DEDICATED TRANSPORT**, that **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** has the **Scouts 9"** ability.

summary.sumDef: If the attacker is suppressed (an enemy unit hit in your Shooting phase by a VEHICLE within 6" of the bearer, or by the bearer’s TRANSPORT): −1 to Hit rolls

goretrack-onslaught · Unleash Hell.gw: **WORLD EATERS** model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, you can select one **VEHICLE** model within 6" of the bearer or, if the bearer is embarked within a **TRANSPORT**, you can select that **TRANSPORT** model. Until the end of the phase, after the selected model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the **Hit roll**.

summary.sumOv: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, if used: the bearer’s unit has Fights First

goretrack-onslaught · Infernal Infusion.gw: **WORLD EATERS** model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer’s unit has the **Fights First** ability.

summary.gist: a WORLD EATERS INFANTRY unit wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT it can embark within embarks in it

gw.target: One **WORLD EATERS INFANTRY** unit from your army and one friendly **TRANSPORT** that it is able to embark within.
gw.effect: If your **WORLD EATERS INFANTRY** unit is wholly within 6" of that **TRANSPORT**, it can embark within it.

summary.gist: a WORLD EATERS VEHICLE moves horizontally through terrain features on Normal and Advance moves

gw.target: One **WORLD EATERS VEHICLE** model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
gw.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a **Normal** or **Advance move**, it can move horizontally through **terrain features**.

summary.gist: one WORLD EATERS unit disembarks from a WORLD EATERS RHINO, set up wholly within 6" of it, within Engagement Range allowed

gw.target: One **WORLD EATERS RHINO** model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
gw.effect: One **WORLD EATERS** unit embarked within your **RHINO** can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of your **RHINO** and can be set up within **Engagement Range** of one or more enemy units.

summary.gist: a WORLD EATERS unit disembarking from this WORLD EATERS RHINO after its Normal move makes an assault disembark move

gw.target: One **WORLD EATERS RHINO** model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
gw.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a **WORLD EATERS** unit disembarks from that model after it has made a **Normal move**, that unit makes an **assault disembark move** (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.

summary.gist: a WORLD EATERS VEHICLE hit by an enemy unit’s attacks makes a Normal move of up to 6" (not with Fury Unleashed in the same phase)

gw.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
gw.target: One **WORLD EATERS VEHICLE** model from your army that was hit by one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
gw.effect: Your model can make a **Normal move** of up to 6".
gw.restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem and the Fury Unleashed Stratagem in the same phase.

summary.gist: a KHORNE BERZERKERS unit embarked within a WORLD EATERS RHINO that was hit makes a disembark move, then a surge move of up to D6+2" (not with Unrelenting Advance in the same phase)

gw.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
gw.target: One **WORLD EATERS RHINO** model from your army that has one or more wounds remaining and was hit by one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
gw.effect: One **KHORNE BERZERKERS** unit embarked within your model can make a **disembark move** and then make a **surge move** of up to D6+2".
gw.restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted by this Stratagem and the Unrelenting Advance Stratagem in the same phase.

brazen-engines · Talons of Butchery.gw: **MAULERFIEND** unit only. This unit’s **Maulerfiend Fists** have **[CLEAVE 2]**.

summary.gist: a DAEMON VEHICLE’s attacks ignore modifiers to BS, WS, Hit rolls and Wound rolls

gw.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly **DAEMON VEHICLE** unit is **selected to attack**.
gw.target: That **DAEMON VEHICLE** unit.
gw.effect:
Your unit’s attacks can ignore modifiers to:
- **BS**.
- **WS**.
- **Hit rolls** and **wound rolls**.

summary.gist: a DAEMON VEHICLE has MOBILE

gw.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly **DAEMON VEHICLE** unit is **selected to move**.
gw.target: That **DAEMON VEHICLE** unit.
gw.effect: Your unit has **MOBILE**.

summary.gist: an unengaged DAEMON VEHICLE (not TITANIC) that an enemy unit shot makes a surge move of up to D6"

gw.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly **unengaged DAEMON VEHICLE** unit (excluding **TITANIC** units) has shot.
gw.target: That **DAEMON VEHICLE** unit.
gw.effect: Your unit can make a **surge move** of up to D6".
